name: Honey Garlic Chicken Drumsticks with Spinach, Avocado & Orange Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F. Using a paper towel, lightly coat a small baking dish with oil.
Add chicken to the dish, place in the oven, and bake for 10 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together ⅔ of the garlic (save the rest for dressing), soy sauce, honey, and parsley flakes. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp honey
½ tsp parsley flakes

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry and transfer spinach to a large bowl. Halve and pit avocado; scoop out, medium dice, and add to bowl. Wash, peel, and quarter orange. Slice 3 of the quarters (save 1 for the dressing) into wedges and add to bowl. Toss salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach
1 avocado
1 orange

instructions.primary_message: Remove dish from oven, pour honey garlic sauce over drumsticks and turn to coat. Place back in the oven and bake until cooked through, another 20-25 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together juice of remaining orange, remaining garlic, oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place drumsticks on a plate, add salad on the side, and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
